latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — fast, free cloud video editing and export without desktop software.

- Upload videos (mp4, mov, avi, wmv) up to 500MB; edit and export in the cloud.
- Simple prompts drive editing: "trim clips, add transitions, export as MP4", etc.
- Automatic setup: obtains free 7-day editing token and session seamlessly for new users.
- Download 1080p MP4 files after editing is complete, typically within 1–2 minutes.
- Clear feedback and error handling for common issues (file types, credits, registration).
- Supports batch uploads, iterative editing, and session persistence for refinements.
